fields.to: Dr. Joanna Pruitt (HO); Wes Tran (IT); Dr. Neha Raman (Epi); Lena Abernathy (PIO)
fields.subject: IIS Export Interface Restored and Verified
fields.body:
Per forensic recovery, MCHD-INT01 has been restored from the immutable cloud backup (04-01) and confirmed clean. The original IIS export file is intact and unaltered. The catch-up file for 04-01 has been generated. No further corruption was found in the backup. All data in the original IIS export file matches the paper records and the ColdSentry logs. The system is now ready for verification.

We recommend proceeding to data-integrity check under Section 6.
fields.signature:
County IT (MC-IT-2026)
Marston County Health Department
Network Operations Center | x2011
